reviews.title: A remarkable and global network
reviews.pros: It allows you to maintain communications on a global scale, which is essential today, in addition to the fact that, due to being one of the best known, it is quite difficult not to find your contacts.
reviews.cons: They are not usually quite clear about how they manage privacy, although there are multiple functions which allow you to have a certain control of your privacy, even today there are certain unknowns based on how they manage your privacy.
reviews.overall: Beyond having certain things, such as how they manage privacy, if you are a person who does not develop an interest in these issues, you can use it without any problem.

reviews.title: Leftist, anti-America, anti-family values + censorship
reviews.pros: A few of my friends are there but hopefully they will continue leaving.
reviews.cons: Too many to name.   The ethos is that of left wing radicals.
reviews.overall: A much overrated product.   One whose time has come.   It will be refreshing to see FB fail and free speech replacements emerge.   It is awkward to use.  More and more we don't know if and who sees our posts and info.   It is hyper-controlled.

reviews.title: Facebook is against freedom of speech
reviews.pros: It has a user-friendly interface.
reviews.cons: However, Facebook does not respect your privacy. It sells your data and spies on you. The worst part is that Facebook censors users with different ideology from its owners. For example, I was blocked from posting on FB 5 times for 30 days last year only and each time for 100% truthful content under false pretext of misinformation. I have PhD. and do research for life - there was no misinformation on my part, just plain fascism on part of Facebook.
reviews.overall: Facebook is a good place to connect with friends. It could be a great platform if it did not censor for ideological differences. I predict it will continue to lose users because of its fascist censorship especially when Truth Social is available.

reviews.title: Find people with common interests.
reviews.pros:
- First, the Facebook has a very simple and user-friendly interface.

- It suggests people, groups and community according to your interests.

- It is available on almost every platform.
reviews.cons: - In the smartphone version, they really push the messenger app to use with Facebook.
reviews.overall: Overall, Facebook is a great place to connect with your friends and family, and to find new people and communities.

reviews.title: Connect with anyone worldwide.
reviews.pros:
- Facebook lets you connect with anyone and make them friend.

- You can make private or public groups for people with the same interests.

- It also offers a marketplace, where you can buy or sell any used or new items.
reviews.cons: - It takes user data unnecessarily that sometimes feels like a threat to privacy.
reviews.overall: Overall, Facebook is a huge platform for people to meet new people and connect with them. It has a lot of unique features on which you can spend your time.

reviews.title: Get Connected with your loved ones.
reviews.pros:
- Facebook makes the world a small place, you can connect be friends with anyone in the world.

- It has very unique features like people you may know and suggested friends so that you don't miss out on anyone.

- It has become very secure lately, you can lock your profile picture, control who can see your profile or comment on your post, and many useful features like this.
reviews.cons: - It has a lot of ads, that sometimes spoil the whole user experience.
reviews.overall: Overall, Facebook is a great tool to get connected with friends, communities, and pages of your choice. It gives you a whole lot of freedom and security at the same time.

reviews.title: Social distancing while being social
reviews.pros: I love the fact that I am able to keep up with all of my friends and family publicly or privately. Facebook's pages are also great to find people with  similar interest or even if you are looking to buy/sell items.
reviews.cons: One thing I dislike, is that Facebook's algorithm in which you can only see certain highlighted people all the time. I have a bunch of friends but I only see a handful of what is posted. Additionally, there are too many adds, especially when trying to watch videos.
reviews.overall: You definitely have to get onto Facebook of you haven't done so already. Its awesome for the older generation to see what's going on in the world and its great for the younger generation to stay connected in a virtual way.

reviews.title: Friends connecting
reviews.pros:
This app connects people to many of their lost friends.

This app also has a video calling facility.

We can also add photos, share news publicly and can do conference call with friends.
reviews.cons:
Sometimes it takes too much time while uploading photos.

Closes automatically.
reviews.overall:
Overall this is the best app for connecting with friends. 

We can find friends from all over the world.

We can talk, share, upload photos.

reviews.title: Best social networking app
reviews.pros:
They are lot of pros about Facebook and they are as follows:

- It connects family, friends from everywhere around the world.

- Chatting options are very good.

- You can share your pictures, photos, memes, and video etc through Facebook web which can be seen by your family and friends.

- Available in every platform
reviews.cons:
There are less cons in Facebook:

-  Sometimes it shows some bad content which not good for your brain like killing people etc.

- People can spread fake news easily on Facebook.

- There are lot of bugs when uploading profile picture on Facebook.
reviews.overall:
Overall Facebook gives a platform people to connect from different countries.

It's provide global access to you.

Facebook helps for meeting new friends and creating relationship between them.

Facebook is also good for business point of view.

reviews.title: Best for communication
reviews.pros: Facebook has many pros as it helps people connecting across the entire world. It also provides an online platform to run our local businesses at a very low price which anyone can afford.
reviews.cons: As there are bunch of fake accounts on facebook running right now who cons people across the world by looting online through net banking etc.
reviews.overall: Overall experience of Facebook app is amazing as this is an amazing innovation which Mark Zuckerberg has given to us. This app help our daily life run so easily and efficiently that nobody had imagined this in past 20 years.

reviews.title: Good features
reviews.pros:
Best application for social media.

You can share yours feeling here.

You can increase your connections with the help of Facebook in a single click.
reviews.cons: Facebook has the entire data of users which is not good.
reviews.overall:
Facebook makes you increase your connections easily by a single click.

You can express your feelings openly.

reviews.title: The Social Network
reviews.pros:
Modern Interface with regular updates.

Free forever.

Groups & Pages offer diverse social content.

Integrated chat application with video calling.

Live Streaming feature.

Backup profile feature.
reviews.cons:
Number of ads has been increasing.

There should be an option to remove videos from feed.
reviews.overall: Facebook is the most popular social network and there is one strong reason for that - simplicity. Its simple and intuitive interface has allowed all age groups to use the platform conveniently to connect socially.

reviews.title: Facebook - Start of an era.
reviews.pros:
(+) Facebook is very easy to use, one can set up an account for free of cost and can start using the application.

(+) Great way to connect and stay in touch with friends and family.

(+) Sharing of photos, videos are easy on Facebook.

(+) Facebook also hosts games that you can play with friends.

(+) Facebook reminds events like birthdays, anniversaries which is one of the best features (Subject to information provided by users)
reviews.cons:
(-) Annoying suggestions to add friends.

(-) Verification of accounts should happen because its easy to open a fake account and cheat users. 

(-) Cyberbullying, harassment, the spread of hatred have increased with the rise of Facebook.

(-) Lots of fake information is posted on Facebook which leads its users in the wrong direction.
reviews.overall: My experience with Facebook is very pleasant, I have made most of my college just by surfing through the meme pages on Facebook. It is a great platform to connect with friends and family. Facebook helps in recollecting memories and remembering birthdays and anniversaries and important occasions. But on the other hand, there is a lot of negativity on Facebook in the form of cyberbullying, spread of hatred by memes and posts and there is no barrier to control such events. The importance of Facebook is coming down these days because of rise of other platforms like Instagram, Snapchat.

reviews.title: Love it for what it is.
reviews.pros: I love that you connect with people, find/host events, share photos and more, promote business, raise money and see news that would not otherwise be publicized.
reviews.cons: I do not like how it was turned into more of an opinion hub. Though this is user error more than anything, Facebook has definitely encouraged it.
reviews.overall: I think like most, I have a love/hate relationship with Facebook. It is great for so many things, but it definitely has a lot of user error downsides.

reviews.title: A bit disingenuous
reviews.pros: I used to heavily use Facebook, both to keep in touch with friends and family, and to stay on top of events within my school communities. It's still exceptional for keeping in touch with people you might otherwise not be able to see in person.
reviews.cons:
Ever walk down the street and then see that same person's profile in your recommended friends' list? Creepy.

You have to manually opt out of stuff like allowing search engines to use your photos, and that's good for Facebook's growth but terrible for the users. Not to mention all the hubbub about fake news...
reviews.overall: A good product for keeping in touch, but keep in mind it does have a hefty privacy cost even though it's a free product.

reviews.title: Connect with your friends on Facebook.
reviews.pros:
- Its fun to share and connect with your friends and family on Facebook.

- The react feature is also cool. The care react is very thoughtful of Facebook.
reviews.cons:
- Sponsored posts on the news feed are quite annoying.

- Facebook app updates are generally huge when they roll out one.

- No dark mode is available.
reviews.overall: I have been on Facebook for years now. I first joined it to connect with my long lost friends. I sometimes look back at my old posts and enjoy the nostalgia.

reviews.title: Facebook
reviews.pros: I have to say I love  almost everything about facebook. I remember when facebook was only for college students. I'm glad they changed that requirement.
reviews.cons: Facebook seems to be everywhere. I would like to see less ads on Facebook but other than that Facebook is a must have in today's world.
reviews.overall: Facebook truly is social media. Everybody has one. It's a way to keep in touch with friends and family and business associates. I cant imagine where we would be in social media without Facebook.

reviews.title: A revolution, yet a dying giant.
reviews.pros:
- Facebook came along and changed everything about social networking. In fact it was the platform that made the term social networking known.

- The entire world is on Facebook and it has become a huge marketplace. You are missing out on a lot of opportunities if you're not using Facebook right.
reviews.cons:
- This platform has become so big that it has entered a phase where people are not sure if it's good for society anymore. People have no idea how much data Facebook collects from their users and laws need to be made to control something like this. 

- The overall value of the Facebook newsfeed has been declining sharply for most people since the last few years. This is particularly because of the increased marketing on the site and privacy concerns.
reviews.overall: Facebook is a generational giant that has played a part in shaping several major events in the world and redefining how humans connect with each other. It has brought about the entire ecosystem of social networking platforms and completely changed our behavior. We are yet to see if this is a good thing.

reviews.title: Facebook for advertisers
reviews.pros: Facebook is a good place to advertise, you reach a wide scope of people. The targeting feature is excellent.  I also enjoy using the messenger platform.
reviews.cons: Facebook ad platform can be pretty buggy and when I need to get in touch with support there is usually no one helpful available.
reviews.overall: Facebook can be a great tool to reach your target audience. It is the industry standard for those with small advertising budget.

reviews.title: My favorite Facebook
reviews.pros: We can make friends across the world easily.  We can share pictures, videos, interests and a lot more. We can also play games with friends. We can raise funds.
reviews.cons: Sometimes we come across fake news, fake accounts.
reviews.overall: Totally it's a very good social networking website to connect and interact with people across the globe by texting, video calls, etc. Facebook was my first social networking account that I've created. It's been many years to date but I still love using Facebook.

reviews.title: Facebook - part of my life
reviews.pros:
The way it connects people is awesome

Easy to post photos, videos

Easy to recollect the memories 

Fantastic use of recommender systems
reviews.cons:
Lots of fake accounts 

Sometimes, missing the feel of being secured.
reviews.overall: To be frank, Facebook really made my day. The way it recollects memories, the way it edit videos. In love with facebook really. I've created a page (education purpose)  now it's receiving more and more likes, followers, it's really helping students in a very good manner.

reviews.title: My first social networking platform
reviews.pros:
Free to use.

Lots of new feature are being added like Facebook Watch, Fundraiser, etc.

We can connect with friends worldwide, chat, play and have fun on Facebook.
reviews.cons: Fake accounts, fake posts are getting on to Facebook. We don't know who's a legitimate user and who's not.
reviews.overall: I started using when I was in my school. Facebook was my first social networking account and I love it. Nowadays, I'm acquainted to using Facebook Watch on Facebook. Its very nice.
